notes.title: EndlessRunner Version 18.5 PRE-RELEASE
notes.notes:
Fixes On this Update:

Steam Login is now happening as part of the Epic Online Services SDK (Connect Interface)

Windows Copy of EndlessRunner now have Easy Anti-Cheat Enabled

The Linux Copy of EndlessRunner Dosn't have any Easy Anti-Cheat as we haven't worked out the Intergration for it. (We have not going to Delpoy Linux Yet)

This version has now been bumped to 18.5 PRE-RELEASE due to the Changes to the Product
